scope: Local v0.1 source-release qualification of exactly two pinned checkpoints and three bounded execution profiles; no registry publication, Git tag or larger-family promotion

source_evidence.coverage_scope: The exact b4d6410 runtime src tree is retained unchanged. Its independently qualified authored-function coverage passes 90% crate-wide and 95% shared/core. Later release-record tests and documentation are outside that production denominator; no new coverage measurement is claimed here.
source_evidence.dependency_scope: The audited lockfile, dependency/feature graph and deny policy are unchanged; later Cargo.toml edits affect packaging include patterns/comments only, so the old manifest byte hash is not claimed equal.
source_evidence.final_archive_policy: Verify the clean committed release source with Cargo package --locked --offline; retain the exact Git commit, inventory, native terminal statuses and archive SHA-256 beside the local archive. This record does not assert a self-referential archive hash.

performance_policy.authorization_context: The user answered 'Yes, continue.' to the explicit request to adopt the controlled baseline while documenting Qwen's unexplained approximately 36-to-27 tokens/s historical slowdown.
performance_policy.decision: Use the controlled September 10 Qwen current-source measurements for future v0.1 comparisons. Retain the September 9 regression as an accepted release limitation, not a corrected measurement or an explained cause.
comparison_constraints: Keep model-loop and public-coordinator timing boundaries separate
Compare matching checkpoint, dtype, backend, source-token lengths, decode counts, warmups and repetitions with observed power/environment provenance
Do not compare instrumented memory timings to uninstrumented performance
Ten-sample nearest-rank p95 is the maximum sample; retained tail alerts are not erased
No exclusive desktop GPU access or continuous thermal/power monitoring is claimed

retained_limitations: Qwen's historical approximately 25% throughput drop remains unexplained and is explicitly accepted for this release
Only profiles named in the two promoted checkpoint records are supported; architecture presence, synthetic coverage and artifact smokes do not promote other models
Quantized corpus-quality guarantees, real-weight MTP support, multimodal towers, long-context quality/performance, training and larger-family completion remain outside this v0.1 scope
Memory traces report process high-water and sampled phase maxima, not exact unsampled peaks or separately attributable host/device allocations
Burn's existing bincode and paste maintenance notices remain documented; no new dependency advisory or license waiver is introduced
